boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten free, under-21-friendly places for a low-key meet-up on campus or nearby in Lawrence.

cards.title: Look through the galleries together
cards.subtitle: Spencer Museum of Art · KU campus
cards.notes: Meet at the entrance, choose a floor, and take turns pointing out one work that starts a conversation. Check the museum’s posted gallery hours before leaving.
cards.short_summary: Two floors of art galleries make an easy, self-paced indoor hang.
cards.evidence_claim: The Spencer Museum states that admission is free for all visitors, always.
cards.access_notes: Open hours and gallery closures are posted on the museum’s visit page; no admission purchase is required.

cards.title: Browse local history exhibits
cards.subtitle: Watkins Museum of History · 1047 Massachusetts St.
cards.notes: Start with a gallery that catches the group’s eye, then compare the local stories or objects each person noticed. Confirm current museum hours before your visit.
cards.short_summary: A downtown history museum for an unhurried, conversation-friendly stop.
cards.evidence_claim: The Watkins Museum of History lists admission as free.
cards.access_notes: The museum lists Tuesday–Saturday public hours; admission does not require a purchase.

cards.title: Spread out for a park-side chat
cards.subtitle: South Park · downtown Lawrence
cards.notes: Bring your own blanket or use open lawn space for a conversation, sketches, or a quiet reset. Stay in general public areas and respect any reserved space.
cards.short_summary: A downtown public-park setting for a simple outdoor meet-up.
cards.evidence_claim: South Park is listed as a Lawrence community park; Kansas law states no charge may be made for park entrance or use of park facilities.
cards.access_notes: Lawrence says its public parks are open daily from 6 a.m. to 11:30 p.m.; avoid any separately reservable area.

cards.title: Take a river-adjacent walk
cards.subtitle: Burcham Park · Lawrence community park
cards.notes: Use the paths for an easy walking conversation, then pause somewhere out of the way to plan the rest of the day. Follow posted park rules and conditions.
cards.short_summary: A named community park for a no-cost walking hang.
cards.evidence_claim: Burcham Park is listed as a Lawrence community park; Kansas law states no charge may be made for park entrance or use of park facilities.
cards.access_notes: Lawrence identifies Burcham as a community park; use general public areas rather than reservable facilities.

cards.title: Meet for an outdoor reset
cards.subtitle: Buford M. Watson, Jr. Park · Lawrence community park
cards.notes: Pick a visible public spot for a short catch-up, a book swap, or a walk. Keep the plan flexible around weather and any posted maintenance notices.
cards.short_summary: A city community park suited to a casual daylight meet-up.
cards.evidence_claim: Buford M. Watson, Jr. Park is listed as a Lawrence community park; Kansas law states no charge may be made for park entrance or use of park facilities.
cards.access_notes: Lawrence identifies this as a community park; use ordinary public access, not a reserved event area.

cards.title: Walk a lap and catch up
cards.subtitle: Centennial Park · Lawrence community park
cards.notes: Set an easy walking pace and let everyone choose a topic for the lap. Use the shared public grounds respectfully and yield space to other park users.
cards.short_summary: A community-park walk that needs no ticket or purchase.
cards.evidence_claim: Centennial Park is listed as a Lawrence community park; Kansas law states no charge may be made for park entrance or use of park facilities.
cards.access_notes: Lawrence identifies Centennial as a community park; reservable shelters or event spaces may have separate rules.

cards.title: Get outside for a group walk
cards.subtitle: Clinton Lake Outlet Park · Lawrence community park
cards.notes: Choose a daytime route that fits the group, keep to established public areas, and take a few minutes to notice the landscape. Check conditions before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A named public park for a no-spend outdoor break.
cards.evidence_claim: Clinton Lake Outlet Park is listed as a Lawrence community park; Kansas law states no charge may be made for park entrance or use of park facilities.
cards.access_notes: Lawrence lists the outlet park among its community parks; use public areas and follow posted safety guidance.

cards.title: Pause by the riverfront
cards.subtitle: Riverfront Park · Lawrence community park
cards.notes: Use the public park setting for a short walk, a photo challenge, or a relaxed conversation. Stay with your group and observe all trail and park signage.
cards.short_summary: A city-managed riverfront setting for a free daytime hang.
cards.evidence_claim: Riverfront Park is listed as a Lawrence community park; Kansas law states no charge may be made for park entrance or use of park facilities.
cards.access_notes: Lawrence lists Riverfront Park as a community park; use normal public access rather than any reservable facility.

cards.title: Take a low-key nature break
cards.subtitle: Prairie Park · Lawrence community park
cards.notes: Meet for a gentle walk and let the group set the pace. Keep to public paths and leave plants, wildlife, and shared spaces undisturbed for the next visitors.
cards.short_summary: A city community park for a quiet, no-cost outdoor pause.
cards.evidence_claim: Prairie Park is listed as a Lawrence community park; Kansas law states no charge may be made for park entrance or use of park facilities.
cards.access_notes: Lawrence identifies Prairie Park as a community park; follow posted rules and use general public areas.

cards.title: Make a simple meetup outdoors
cards.subtitle: Holcom Park · Lawrence community park
cards.notes: Use open public space for a walk-and-talk or a shared study break before heading back to campus. Check posted notices and avoid any booked facility area.
cards.short_summary: A Lawrence community park for an easy, free group reset.
cards.evidence_claim: Holcom Park is listed as a Lawrence community park; Kansas law states no charge may be made for park entrance or use of park facilities.
cards.access_notes: Lawrence lists Holcom Park among its community parks; general park access is separate from reservable facilities.
